The calendar is set up on the "Agenda-manifestations" dataset, with the label and crowd sourcing configured. The form is valid and saved.

- **Dataset:** "Agenda-manifestations" (`/$allOf-0/datasets/0`).
- **Label field:** "Nom de l'évenement" (`nomevenement`), so each event shows its name.
- **Crowd sourcing:** turned on (`/$allOf-3/crowdSourcing` = true), so visitors can propose new events.

Turning on crowd sourcing also made a "Jeu de données des contributions externes" field appear (the dataset where proposals are stored). I left it empty because you didn't ask for it. Check whether proposals need it set before they can be stored. I also left the colour, edition and description settings at their defaults.
